top_news.title: A Moving-Horizon Approximate Branch-and-Reduce Method for Deep Classification Trees
top_news.dek: A new moving-horizon branch-and-reduce method enables training near-optimal deep classification trees on large-scale datasets with continuous features.
top_news.brief: Researchers have introduced a hierarchical root-subtree optimization framework to address the scalability issues of deep decision trees. By combining branch-and-reduce for root-level problems with approximation techniques, the method overcomes traditional limitations in feature selection and tree depth, offering a more efficient path to interpretable, high-accuracy models.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing a hierarchical decision tree optimization process

top_news.title: Durable Objects - Pending I/O operations allow Durable Objects to continue long-running work without a connected client
top_news.dek: Cloudflare Durable Objects now support pending I/O operations to keep instances alive after client disconnection.
top_news.brief: Durable Objects can now maintain active state while handling background I/O tasks, even without a connected client. This is the default behavior for Workers with a compatibility date of 2026-10-01 or later, ensuring long-running agent jobs are not prematurely evicted.

top_news.title: Claude’s new auto eval tool
top_news.dek: Anthropic has released new eval tooling for Claude Code, including build_eval and hill-climb commands.
top_news.brief: The new Claude API plugin provides developers with tools to build evaluations, verify graders, and iteratively improve application performance. The hill-climbing feature automates the refinement process, marking a significant shift in how developers approach model evaluation and optimization.
top_news.image_alt: Screenshot of Claude Code terminal interface

top_news.title: Modal Clusters are generally available
top_news.dek: Modal Clusters are now generally available, enabling distributed computing workloads via a simple decorator.
top_news.brief: Modal has launched @modal.clustered, a new primitive designed to handle large-scale training and inference across multiple nodes. The system integrates with existing Modal features like Volumes and Cloud Bucket Mounts, allowing developers to orchestrate complex distributed jobs without managing underlying hardware.

top_news.title: OpenDLSS: A Vulkan Reimplementation of Nvidia's DLSS 5 Neural Rendering Network
top_news.dek: OpenDLSS provides a bit-exact Vulkan reimplementation of Nvidia's DLSS 5 neural rendering network.
top_news.brief: This project replicates the 71-block Swin/ViT network used in DLSS 5, achieving bit-exact output compared to the original. It supports FP8 execution on tensor cores and includes a WebGPU implementation for browser-based rendering, though users must provide their own model weights.

primary.summary: Durable Objects remain active while handling a request from a connected client. This behavior is the default for Workers with a compatibility date of 2026-10-01 or later. To use it with an earlier date, add the durable_object_io_tasks_prevent_eviction compatibility flag. primary.title: AI Gateway - Pay for AI inference with Machine Payments
primary.summary: AI Gateway now supports Machine Payments in beta. With Machine Payments, clients can use the x402 protocol to pay for eligible inference requests directly from a stablecoin wallet instead of maintaining a prepaid credit balance. Machine Payments is available for the /ai/run endpoint with select open models. To request x402 payment, authenticate with a Cloudflare API token and include the Cloudflare-specific Payment-Method: x402 header: curl -iX POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID/ai/run" \ --header "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" \ --header
